team_arena: New Orleans Pelicans (Smoothie King Center, owned by LSED)
mechanism: R.S. 39:100.1 Sports Facility Assistance Fund (Acts 2001 No.1203; 2002 1st Ex.Sess. No.146) + 2012 Arena Use Agreement
what_is_captured: State income tax of NONRESIDENT pro athletes/franchise personnel (visitors + nonresident home personnel) -> SFAF -> LSED -> paid in cash to Pelicans/Saints as lease entitlement
visiting_player_share: visiting NBA players ~51-77% of Pelicans amount (model, 1.0-1.5 duty days/visit)
notes: statute says facility renovation/operations or LSED contractual obligations; actual use = cash to team owner (Benson)
labels: b (audits, statute, Senate budget decks); a (visitor share)

mechanism: Quality Jobs rebate (2002 relocation law) -> state-paid equivalent under Arena Use Agreement
what_is_captured: Rebate of up to ~5-6% of payroll incl. player salaries, capped $3.65M/yr; QJ contract expired FY2022, state pays equivalent via LED 20-931 through FY2029
notes: payroll-based subsidy whose base is NBA salaries

mechanism: IC 36-7-31 Marion County Professional Sports Development Area (1997; expanded 2005, 2019)
what_is_captured: Captures state sales/use tax, state AGI tax on individuals (incl. resident and nonresident athletes, team employees), Marion County LIT, F&B tax generated at Gainbridge, Lucas Oil, Convention Center, Victory Field, Colts practice facility; state share capped $16M/yr to 2040
actual_amounts: Sports PSDA: 2021 $20.55M; 2022 $24.35M; 2023 $26.63M (CIB audits); pledged to MCCRFA Series 2021A (~$401M) incl. ~$254M Pacers renovation
visiting_player_share: visiting NBA players ~$2.0-2.4M/yr (state AGI+Marion LIT) ~8-9% of Sports PSDA; marginal visiting tax may hit state cap
notes: arena-generated taxes (incl. players' income tax) count as generally applicable taxes for IRC 141 -> tax-exempt bonds

mechanism: SB 1501 (2026), Oregon Laws 2026 ch. 74: Oregon Arena Fund
what_is_captured: Transfers = PIT withheld by Rose Quarter "operating organizations" (incl. Blazers players/staff), construction withholding, and OEA estimate of PIT paid by "performers" (incl. VISITING NBA teams) from 9/1/2027; supports ~$365M state debt; conditional on sale, joint authority, 20-yr lease
notes: first explicit statutory capture of visiting players' income tax for an NBA arena since LA 2001-02
labels: b (enrolled bill, LRO, budget report); a (visitor share)

mechanism: Professional privilege tax on NBA/NHL players (2009); repealed PC 760 (2014) - NHL after 4/24/2014, NBA after 6/1/2016
what_is_captured: $2,500 per game, max 3 games ($7,500)/yr; proceeds to team-run city-owned arenas
actual_amounts: ~$3.5M/yr NBA+NHL (fiscal review via WPLN); Memphis 2016 settlement refunding $2.38M to 900+ players
visiting_player_share: visiting ~92% by construction (41 games x ~13-15 players x $2,500 vs home roster $112.5K)
labels: b (TN DOR); c (WPLN, Commercial Appeal via Sportsnaut); a

mechanism: 2015 Act 60 - NO earmark; "jock tax" used as political justification
what_is_captured: State: $4M/yr GPR grant appropriation (cap $80M, sunset 2035-36) + $4M/yr GPR to WCD offset by $4M/yr cut in Milwaukee County aid; backs $108.1M WCD appropriation bonds (2016)
actual_amounts: Projection: DOR NBA-related income tax $717.16M 2016-2046 (incremental $0.9M 2016-17 -> $39.1M 2046-47; base $6.5M 2014); LFB: Bucks players+employees paid ~$10.7M in 2012; no published actuals
visiting_player_share: visiting players ~$2.9-3.7M/yr (2022-26 model) of ~$11M NBA total (~30%)
notes: DOR actual NBA collections not published (records request needed)
